therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell exhaustion reversal and anti-tumor immune response activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer and urothelial cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: objective response rate per RECIST v1.1

results.effect_size: ORR: 50.0% (95% CI: 11.8–88.2) for 800mg+pemetrexed/carboplatin, 53.8% (95% CI: 25.1–80.8) for 800mg+gemcitabine/cisplatin, 33.3% (95% CI: 4.3–77.7) for 1200mg+pemetrexed/carboplatin, 39.0% (95% CI: 24.2–55.5) for 1200mg+gemcitabine/cisplatin
results.target_engagement_evidence: Avelumab serum concentrations achieved therapeutic levels with geometric mean concentrations of 172-300 μg/mL at 1 hour post-dose
biomarker_changes: PD-L1 expression measured at baseline and cycle 2 day 8
Tumor mutational burden: mean 2.5-4.4 mutations per megabase across treatment arms
subgroup_findings: PD-L1 positive patients: 28/41 in main cohort at baseline
Anti-drug antibodies developed in 15/67 total participants
safety_signals: Grade 3+ neutropenia in 21/41 patients in main cohort
Grade 3+ anemia in 6/41 patients in main cohort
Serious cardiac events including myocardial infarction, cardiomyopathy
results.dose_information: Avelumab 800mg or 1200mg every 3 weeks in combination with pemetrexed/carboplatin or gemcitabine/cisplatin
